description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the methods of EmployeeLanguageDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup, multiple test cases for save, get, search, delete, and allowed language functionalities related to employee languages.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for EmployeeLanguageDao operations, including CRUD and search functionalities for employee languages within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates EmployeeLanguageDao, and populates test data.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Tests saving an EmployeeLanguage entity and verifies persistence.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an EmployeeLanguage entity by employee, language, and fluency IDs.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Tests searching for employee languages by filters.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeLanguagesCount
methods.description: Tests counting employee languages based on search filters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLanguagesWithLanguageIds
methods.description: Tests filtering employee languages with specific language IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Tests deletion of employee language entries.

methods.name: testGetAllowedEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Tests retrieving allowed languages for an employee.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedLicensesCount
methods.description: Tests counting allowed employee languages for an employee.
